name: Shiro Horitsu
description: A quiet, trustworthy editorial theme for boutique law firms and legal practices, set like a well-kept statute book: washi-ivory pages, generous whitespace, EB Garamond titles with an indigo italic second voice, an asymmetric grid drawn with hairline column rules, section marks and numbered indexes, and large calm photographs; with practice areas, attorney profiles, a first-consultation flow with a fee ledger and FAQ, insights, a newsletter and contact with office hours, a not-legal-advice disclaimer, in sumi ink, deep indigo and stone grey, plus a night-office dark variation.

fonts.role: titles, leads, numerals, the wordmark and the indigo italic second voice
